review_candidates.title: Modern Workplace Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Overview The Modern Workplace Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and operating Microsoft Modern Workplace solutions with a strong focus on identity, endpoint management, data security, threat protection, and Microsoft Copilot. Key Responsibilities Designing, implementing, and maintaining MWP solutions such as (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive for Business) Designing, implementing, and maintaining Entra ID, M365 Defender Suite, M365 Purview, and In
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that enhance collaboration and productivity. Key Competencies Expertise in Microsoft 365 services and cloud collaboration tools Demonstrable experience and knowledge with the architecture, design, configuration, and troubleshooting of Microsoft 365 products and solutions such as: Entra ID. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in communication engineering, Computer Science, or Information Technology or a related field. 2 to 4 years experience in same role Relevant Microsoft cloud security certifications such as: SC-900 (Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals).
